payload.why: the only URLs this package opens are the running engine's own same-origin routes, /target/slot::composition-engine and /boot, and it opens them because the generic target sender cannot carry this exchange: the sender's reply lane does not route a complete-frame back for a slot:: target, so an awaited composition transaction never returns, and the /target route additionally admits a write only with the running-command-list basis header plus a 428 basis-rotation retry, which the sender has no way to express. Every reach is same-origin to the engine that is already serving the surface; no outside host, credential or third party is involved, and the moment the sender routes slot:: replies and carries the basis header this record is deleted with the fetches.

payload.name: checkpoint-note
payload.description: Deterministic (no-AI) workflow dispatched by the !! input-shortcut: append one composition-checkpoint published-record capturing the block's text + source node at dispatch time. Proves the inline command-composer can dispatch a deterministic workflow to slot::workflow as pure DATA (contrast: space -> ai-records-producer is AI). The caller (the input-shortcut dispatch payload) supplies typed_text + node_ref + run_id; this def owns only the write.

payload.name: write-document
payload.description: Generic pass-through document write: caller supplies a fully-formed record (address + payload), and this action owns only the write. Downstream pipelines can persist authored composition documents without Documents learning the caller's domain vocabulary.

payload.name: import-document
payload.description: Blind adapter: turn produced content into an editable composition document plus a lightweight index pointer. Caller supplies {doc_id, title, summary?, source?, status?} plus either structured `sections` or a `body_html` string. This action owns the document format and address convention by running the generic import-content-document.mjs mapper, then writing the document at its scene address and its composition-document-index pointer.

payload.name: read-document-publication-snapshot
payload.description: Read a canonical Documents body at its owner address and derive its exact publication hash. Caller-authored hashes are never accepted as truth; the reply is an ephemeral formatter input and must not be persisted by a delivery owner.
